title: Bout Agreement Basics
bulletin: Welcome to the desk. Today it's just BOUT AGREEMENTS. Check the name, weight class and signature against the file card.
text: A bout agreement is valid only if the fighter's NAME and SIGNATURE match the file card, and the WEIGHT CLASS matches the division on file. Typos count. Forgeries count double.

title: Purse Must Match
text: The SHOW PURSE and WIN BONUS on the agreement must match the numbers you negotiated (see the file card). Managers 'round up'. Do not let them.

title: Weigh-In Tolerance
bulletin: FIGHT WEEK: WEIGH-IN SHEETS. Non-title fighters may come in up to 1 lb over the limit; title fights must be on it. Missed weight? Cancel, catchweight, or send them back to the sauna to re-weigh.
text: Non-title fighters may weigh in up to the tolerance over the division limit. Title fights: on the limit or under. Over that is a MISSED WEIGHT: cancel, catchweight, or send them to the sauna for a re-weigh.

title: Pre-Fight Medicals
bulletin: NEW: MEDICAL CLEARANCES. Doctor and licence # must be on the registry, and the exam must be within 90 days of fight night. 'Dr. Steve (Online Certificate)' is not a doctor.
text: Medical clearances must be signed by a physician on the Commission registry (name AND licence number). The EXAM DATE must be no more than 90 days before fight night. Required scans are listed below.

title: Camp Expense Reimbursement
bulletin: NEW: CAMP EXPENSE REPORTS. Every line must match its receipt and the total must add up. Use the calculator. Trust nobody.
text: We reimburse camp expenses. Each line item must match its attached RECEIPT, and the TOTAL must equal the sum of the items. The calculator (C) does the maths if you're a fighter.

title: Licensed Managers Only
announce: COMMISSION CRACKS DOWN ON UNLICENSED MANAGERS; DOZENS OF 'COUSINS' SUDDENLY UNEMPLOYED
bulletin: NEW: manager licences. The rep's licence number on every bout agreement must match the Commission registry (rulebook). Glen is not licensed. Glen will never be licensed.
text: Fighter representatives must hold an Athletic Commission licence. The REP. LICENCE # on the agreement must match that rep's number in the registry below, digit for digit. Unlicensed reps (dads, cousins, 'Glen from the gym') cannot sign.

title: Fighter Licence Card
announce: RINGER SCANDAL: FIGHTER'S 'TWIN BROTHER' WINS ON HIS BEHALF; COMMISSION DEMANDS PHOTO ID
bulletin: NEW: FIGHTER LICENCE CARDS come stapled to bout agreements. Compare the photo with the face at your door. Yes, people send their cousins.
text: Every bout agreement comes with the fighter's Commission licence card. The PHOTO must match the face in your doorway, the LICENCE # must match the agreement, and the card must not EXPIRE before the bout date.

title: Per-Item Cap & Luxuries
announce: PROMOTION CAPS CAMP EXPENSES AFTER FIGHTER BILLS A JET SKI 'FOR CARDIO'
bulletin: NEW: expense cap. No item over the cap, and no luxuries: jet skis, pythons and bottle service are not camp.
text: No single line item may exceed the per-item cap. Luxuries, pets, nightlife, jewellery and 'spiritual' services are not camp expenses, receipt or no receipt.

title: Sponsor Exclusivity
bulletin: NEW: SPONSOR PATCH AGREEMENTS land on your desk now. One sponsor per category per fighter: check the file card.
text: A fighter may not wear two competing sponsors in the same category. Check the sponsors already on file before approving a new patch.

title: KO Suspensions
announce: COMMISSION ENFORCES KO SUSPENSIONS AFTER FIGHTER RETURNS 'SEEING THREE REFEREES'
bulletin: NEW: KO suspensions. Check MED. SUSP. on the file card: a suspended fighter can't be cleared or booked before it ends.
text: A fighter on medical suspension (after a KO/TKO loss) cannot be cleared or booked for a fight before the suspension ends. Compare the bout or fight date with the suspension on file.

title: Exclusivity Clause
bulletin: NEW: the exclusivity clause is mandatory. A rival promotion poached a guy mid-camp using a 'loophole'. Agreements must say INCLUDED.
text: Every bout agreement must include the standard EXCLUSIVITY clause. No clause, no fight. Lawyers love loopholes.

title: Anti-Doping Program
announce: PROMOTION LAUNCHES 'COMPREHENSIVE' ANTI-DOPING PROGRAM; FIGHTERS ASK WHAT 'COMPREHENSIVE' MEANS
bulletin: NEW: ANTI-DOPING LAB REPORTS. Panel complete, sample fresh (30 days), no banned codes without a TUE. The supplement industry sends its regards.
text: All fighters are tested. The PANEL must cover every test class listed below, the sample must be COLLECTED no more than 30 days before fight night, and any banned substance code fails unless an approved TUE is attached. Metabolites over the picogram limit fail.

title: Press Credentials
announce: PROMOTION TO 'REVIEW' MEDIA CREDENTIALS; REPORTERS NERVOUSLY CHECK LANYARDS
bulletin: NEW: PRESS CREDENTIALS. Accredited outlets only, banned reporters stay banned, and the photo must match the face at your door.
text: Credentials must be issued by an accredited outlet, must not belong to a banned reporter, and the PHOTO must match the person in your doorway.

title: Whereabouts Failures
bulletin: NEW: whereabouts strikes. More than 2 strikes on a lab report is a fail. 'I was at a cousin's wedding' is not a location.
text: Three missed whereabouts filings counts as a failed test. A report showing MORE than the allowed strikes must be denied.

title: Court Date Conflicts
bulletin: NEW: COURT NOTICES. If a fighter's court date clashes with their fight, or they're under a no-travel order, deny (pull them).
text: A fighter cannot fight on or after a court date in the same week. Fighters with no-travel orders cannot fight outside their home region.

title: Mandatory MRI
announce: COMMISSION ORDERS MANDATORY MRIs AFTER FIGHTER'S BRAIN DESCRIBED AS 'VIBES-BASED'
bulletin: NEW: MRI REQUIRED on every medical. Somebody cleared a fighter who shouldn't have been cleared. (It was you.)
text: All medicals must now include a current MRI.

title: Zero Tolerance Weigh-Ins
announce: ATHLETIC COMMISSION TIGHTENS WEIGH-IN RULES; ONE-POUND ALLOWANCE ABOLISHED
bulletin: NEW: ZERO TOLERANCE WEIGH-INS. The one-pound allowance is gone. Thank the fighters you waved through.
text: The one pound allowance is gone. Every fighter must weigh in at or under the division limit.

title: Work Visas
announce: INTERNATIONAL EXPANSION: FIGHTERS NOW NEED WORK VISAS, PASSPORTS, AND A LAWYER
bulletin: NEW: WORK VISAS for international cards. Athlete visa only, passport valid past the event, and check the arrest record.
text: International events require a valid work visa. Passport must not expire before the event date. Some countries deny entry to anyone with a listed arrest.

title: Eye Exams
bulletin: NEW: EYE EXAM required on every medical. Long story. Two rounds. One eye.
text: After a fighter fought with one eye for two rounds, an Eye Exam is now required on every medical.

title: New Picogram Thresholds
announce: ANTI-DOPING AGENCY CUTS PICOGRAM THRESHOLD IN HALF; NUTRITION SUPPLEMENT INDUSTRY IN SHAMBLES
bulletin: NEW: picogram threshold halved, and two new substances banned. The lab bought a better machine after the last scandal.
text: The picogram threshold for metabolites is halved.

title: Betting Sponsor Ban
announce: REGULATORS BAN BETTING SPONSORS FROM FIGHT SHORTS; BOOKIES DEVASTATED, BRIEFLY
bulletin: NEW: BETTING sponsors are banned from fighter kits.
text: Betting companies can no longer appear on fighter kits.

title: Crypto Sponsor Freeze
announce: AFTER THIRD RUGPULL, LEAGUE BANS CRYPTO SPONSORS; MOON NOT REACHED
bulletin: NEW: CRYPTO sponsors are banned. The moon was not reached.
text: Crypto exchanges and coins are banned sponsor categories.

title: Shorter Exam Window
bulletin: NEW: medical exams must now be within 60 days of fight night.
text: Medical exams must now be dated no more than 60 days before fight night.

title: Expense Crackdown
announce: NEW OWNERS AUDIT CAMP EXPENSES; 'WHY IS THERE A JET SKI?'
bulletin: NEW: per-item expense cap cut to $2,000. The new owners have seen the jet ski.
text: The per-item cap is cut and luxury items are banned outright.
